supporting_observations.claim: The user maria.lopez opened a macro-enabled Word document named 'Statement.docm' from the Downloads folder.
WINWORD.EXE spawned a hidden PowerShell process with a base64 encoded command.
The encoded PowerShell command downloaded a script 'u.ps1' from a GitHub repository associated with 'harbor-dental-it'.
The PowerShell process established a network connection to the internal proxy to download the script.
The PowerShell process executed a DLL named 'svchelper.dll' located in the user's AppData folder using rundll32.exe.

claims_not_established: The full contents and functionality of the downloaded u.ps1 script and svchelper.dll are not available.
additional_evidence_needed: Full dump of svchelper.dll and u.ps1 for malware analysis.
unrelated_findings: PowerShell activity at 14:03 UTC running C:\Scripts\endpoint-inventory.ps1 under SYSTEM account (T023-00165).
PowerShell activity at 14:16 UTC using Invoke-WebRequest to nuget.org (T023-00265).
